summary: Offerpad Solutions Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the filing of a prospectus supplement related to its existing Open Market Sales Agreement with Jefferies LLC. Under the agreement, the company may sell up to $69.7 million of its Class A common stock from time to time through Jefferies as sales agent. The filing includes a legal opinion from Latham & Watkins LLP validating the shares. This is a routine at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program, not a special-situation event such as a tender offer, acquisition, or restructuring. No deal terms, premium, or board recommendation are provided.
